 La Roja has already qualified for the quarterfinals with four wins from its four games so far, and will be keen to maintain its three-point lead over second-place rival England ahead of a showdown fixture between the two teams in Madrid on Sunday.
 The Czech Republic , meanwhile, props up the group after losing all four games while conceding a hefty 10 goals along the way. With any hope of qualification for the last eight long gone, Santi Denia’s team must now aim to avoid relegation, with the host three points behind fellow struggler Croatia.
 More from CNET
 The Czech Republic hosts Spain at the Stadion Letná in Prague on Thursday, Nov. 12. Kickoff is at  8:45 p.m. CET  local time, which is 7:45 p.m. GMT in the UK. That’s a  2:45 p.m. ET or 11:45 a.m. PT  kickoff in the US and Canada, and a  6:45 a.m. AEDT  start on Friday in Australia.

 How to watch the Czech Republic vs. Spain match online from anywhere using a VPN
 If you’re traveling abroad and want to keep up with all the action while away from home, a VPN can help enhance your privacy and security when streaming. 
 VPNs encrypt your traffic and prevent your internet service provider from throttling your speeds, and can also be helpful when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks while traveling, adding an extra layer of protection for your devices and logins. VPNs are legal in many countries, including the US and Canada, and can be used for legitimate purposes such as improving online privacy and security. 
 However, some streaming services may have policies that restrict VPN use for accessing region-specific content. If you’re considering a VPN for streaming, check the platform’s terms of service to ensure compliance. 
 If you choose to use a VPN, follow the provider’s installation instructions to ensure you’re connected securely and in compliance with applicable laws and service agreements. Some streaming platforms may block access when a VPN is detected, so verifying if your streaming subscription allows VPN usage is crucial.

The service is also included with a Prime membership.
